name: Little N's Chaotic Camera
descriptionTemplate:
{Golden Harmony}: {Arithmetica Harmony} now only increases Arithmetica Cost by 1. Each 1% DMG Amplification increases {Occult Research} Depth by 1%.
{Dimensional Gift}: Gain 1 random Dimensional Image Relic at the start of exploration. Hand Limit +1.
{Transit Fatigue}: All HP recovery effects -50% in battle. When "Burial" is selected at "Faded Bones," the effect changes to restore 25% Max HP.
{Blessed Ritual}: Rewards for defeating Phase 1, 2, and 3 Bosses are replaced with a choice of 3 Blessed Relics.
{Motion Vertigo}: All Awakeners start battle with 50% less current Aliemus and Keyflare.
{Evernight Rail}: All Awakeners gain +100% to their Base Aliemus and Keyflare Cap at the start of exploration.
lore: Oh no! It's completely trashed! Wait... it's still working? But look at all these restrictions!
